BL-1120 — handoffd must not abort a master-main merge it did not start
What it solves: Source: .swarmforge/operator/INTAKE-handoffd-abort-stomps-human-merge.md Related: BL-891, BL-919, BL-920, BL-925, BL-1096. Evidence join: 70252b02a. Optional intake ask 3 (surface rename/rename in BL-891 note) deferred to a follow-up if still wanted after this fix.
Approval context: Defect: master-main-reconcile-merge! always runs git merge --abort on any non-zero merge exit, including when MERGE_HEAD already existed (human mid-merge). Confirm the skip/surface behaviour and that ticks that did not start the merge never abort it.
BL-1120 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1120" (or "reject BL-1120 <reason>") to act.
